run_openai_chat_completion_reasoning: run the vLLM OpenAI chat completion example that generates responses with reasoning from a reasoning model like DeepSeek R1
create_openai_client_vllm: create an OpenAI client configured to connect to a local vLLM API server at http://localhost:8000/v1
list_available_models: list available models from the vLLM server and select the first model for chat completions
generate_reasoning_response: generate a chat completion response that includes both reasoning and content fields from a reasoning model
extract_reasoning_content: extract the reasoning and content fields separately from an OpenAI chat completion response
